Name: AI Observability by OpenObserve
Tagline: OpenTelemetry-native observability for agents and LLMs
Description: Your agent cost $40 and took 34 seconds. But why? OpenObserve traces every agent session across models, tools, services, datastores, and user sessions so you can see exactly where time, money, and quality went. Detect loops, run online evals, and follow failures from the LLM call through your backend and database, alongside the logs, traces, and metrics from the rest of your production stack.

Name: Typewise Nova
Tagline: AI customer experience that builds and improves itself
Description: Nova is the AI Operator that builds and improves your AI customer experience team, no developer required. Describe in plain language how customers should be handled and connect your tools. Nova builds the agents, tests them on past tickets and shows you what failed before anything goes live. Once running, it monitors quality and proposes fixes 24/7 for approval. Agents resolve whole requests, from orders and refunds to plan changes, across email, chat and WhatsApp. Unresolved requests are free.

Name: iPhone Duo
Tagline: The largest iPhone display ever. In a thin, foldable design.
Description: Introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone. When open, it’s the thinnest iPhone with the largest display ever — 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max. And it has an outer display with more than 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a durable, pocketable design. It’s an iPhone unlike any iPhone.

Name: FreeScan.app
Tagline: Fix what’s hurting your visibility, trust, and conversions
Description: Audit any public URL for free, no signup. FreeScan uncovers problems and missed opportunities across SEO, AEO, GEO, security, accessibility, and design. Every finding includes evidence, why it matters, and how to fix it. Pro runs automated site-wide audits, organizes results into SEO, AI Visibility, and Fixes workspaces, tracks improvements and regressions, creates agent-ready artifacts, connects coding agents through MCP, monitors uptime, and sends weekly reports and downtime alerts.

Name: Suno v6
Tagline: The first Suno model built with the music industry
Description: Suno v6 is a new generation of music models in three flavors: flagship v6, exploratory v6-wild, and free v6-mini. Edit one section or lyric without remaking the track, mash up your own songs, and start from text, audio, images, or video.

Name: AirPods 5
Tagline: 1.5x Active Noise Cancellation, AI Siri, Live Translation
Description: AirPods 5 brings better active noise cancellation to the open-ear design, along with a smarter Siri that can hold real conversations and live translation for talking across languages. Built for calls, workouts, and everyday listening. Available September 18, 2026.

Name: Athenic AI
Tagline: Beat the market with 90+ datasets and AI made for analysis
Description: Find investment opportunities before everyone else does. Athenic provides $50,000 of licensed institutional stock data plus AI specialized for analysis. Screen for advanced filters in plain English, get alerted on news or price moves, and automate deep-dive fundamentals research.

Name: Viso Now
Tagline: Build computer vision applications with AI
Description: Viso Now is a self-building AI vision platform that turns images, video, and camera feeds into working computer vision applications. Describe what you want to understand, and Viso Now builds the agentic vision logic and custom live dashboards. All without model training, annotation, or writing code.

Name: Modeinspect
Tagline: Design production UI in your codebase
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Most software is designed twice: a picture first, then again in code. Intent drifts in between. Modeinspect is the AI design canvas for working on the real thing. Connect your codebase, open an existing screen, and design with your components, tokens, live data, states, and breakpoints. Explore with AI. Keep details that matter. When ready, publish your changes live or send them to engineering for review. You decide when they go live. The canvas is not the destination. The product is.

Name: Desert Ant Labs
Tagline: Small specialized AI models for speech, text, vision
Description: Desert Ant Labs builds small AI models that run on your phone or browser, no internet, no per-use cost. Instead of one big model doing everything, they make small ones, each nailing one task, across speech, text, and vision. Add any model in a few lines of code via one SDK. Free up to 100k monthly active devices.

Name: Live Captions by Subanana
Tagline: Your whole audience follows, in their own language
Description: You speak once. Your audience scans a QR code, picks a language, and follows you live on their own phone — reading it, or hearing it. Put two languages on the big screen, or send a clean feed into OBS and vMix.

Name: Whip
Tagline: Youtube for interactive web experiences
Description: Whip is a feed for the interactive expeirences. Discover and play games, 3D worlds, interactive stories, generative art, data visualizations, music toys, and more directly in your browser. Creators get channels, shareable pages, play counts, likes, and comments, so their work can build an audience instead of disappearing into a timeline.

Name: Mock Magic Presets
Tagline: Use saved presets to quickly get a branded device video
Description: Most mockup tools stop at images. Mock Magic turns a screen recording into a polished device video, in your brand colors, in the browser, in seconds. No Photoshop, no After Effects, nothing to install. Upload an image or video, pick a device (iPhone 17 Pro, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch and more), set a brand color with a hex code or add your own background, and download. Save your setup once and reuse it, so every mockup for your app store, website or socials matches.

Name: Wealthfolio
Tagline: Local-first personal finance with optional broker sync
Topics: Open Source, Investing, GitHub, Personal Finance
Description: Wealthfolio is an open-source personal finance app for tracking investments, net worth, spending and financial goals. Your financial data is stored locally and the core app works without an account or subscription. Use it on desktop, iPhone, iPad or self-host it. If you want less manual upkeep, Wealthfolio Connect adds automatic brokerage sync, end-to-end encrypted device sync and household sharing.

Name: Speechmark
Tagline: Private, on-device meeting notes for Mac
Description: Speechmark is a private macOS meeting-notes app. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings entirely on your Mac — decisions, action items, speaker-attributed transcripts. No bot joins the call, no account, one-time price. Integrates well with Claude Code using MCP server.

Name: Drive
Tagline: Vehicle telemetry for your next weekend drive with LPR alert
Description: I spent a few years as a design lead on autonomous driving for Android Auto, then spent my weekends in a 27-year-old car doing the exact opposite. Drive came out of that gap. It turns the phone already in your car into a telemetry rig — g-force, braking, cornering, the whole trace. It also flags license plate reader cameras as you approach them, since I like my privacy. No wiring loom. No dongle. No laptop. No sign up. Just driving fun.

Name: hob
Tagline: The professional workspace for your whole agent stack
Description: Run complex agent work while staying in control. hob brings multiple models and independent workflows into one professional workspace. Agents can shape the workspace around each task, coordinate through it, and guide you inside it. Run, review, automate, and recover agent work in the same system, so you can direct more parallel work without piecing together the infrastructure.

Name: Thousand
Tagline: Git-backed docs for humans and agents
Description: Git-backed docs with real access control, in one markdown repo with folder-level access where teammates, outsiders and AI agents each see exactly their folders.

Name: Vibe Eyes
Tagline: Put your pets in your macOS menu bar
Description: I miss my dog when I am at my desk all day. So now he lives in my menu bar. Drop in a photo and Vibe Eyes turns your own pet into a tiny animated avatar up there. It follows your cursor, blinks at you, winks when you click and looks up when you have been away. Small stuff, but you catch yourself glancing up and smiling. Eleven pets built in, free. Making your own is a $14.99 one-time unlock plus your own AI key. No subscription, no backend, your photo never touches my server.

Name: Gojo
Tagline: Local dictation and everyday Mac tools in your notch
Description: Gojo puts local dictation, clipboard history, window controls, a file shelf, and media controls in your MacBook notch. Download a speech model, then dictate into the field you're using. Recognition runs on your Mac in local mode. Includes calendar, battery, camera, and display controls. macOS 14+. Three-day trial; monthly and one-time licenses.
